mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth rate below 1% quarter-over-quarter signals weakening economic demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 QoQ < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points month-over-month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE MoM > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% year-over-year signals supply-side constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST MoM > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 month-over-month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS MoM < -100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 1%.
